system.description:
You are able to more quickly utilize the substitution technique allowing you a swifter escape with smaller margins for error. When you would take damage from an attack you may increase your AC by +3 against the triggering attack and all subsequent attacks until the beginning of your next turn. If this bonus would cause the attack to miss, you may move up to half of your movement away. If you activate this jutsu as a result of making a saving throw, you must still make the saving throw even if your movement would move you to the outside of an effects range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, you may choose to attach a highly explosive paper tag to the object you are swapping places with. If you do, regardless if a creature hits you or not, you may move up to your full movement way, as the tag explodes, forcing all creatures within 20 feet of the space where you cast this jutsu to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the AC bonus to +4. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank, increase the damage of the explosive tag by 2d6. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank or higher, increase the AC bonus to +5.
